name: template-library-loader
body: Template library loader: resolves the library root from the deck config — the `templates:` path when set (relative to the deck root, or absolute), else the local `templates/`; a configured path is authoritative (the local `templates/` is consulted only when no path is configured), and neither resolvable is a templates error (templates-dir-required) — then reads the resolved root via an fs.FS rooted at it, validates it fail-fast in the templates-dir-validation order (library.yaml; structure — the library structure is library.yaml, slides/, sections/, themes/, media/, and any other top-level entry (`.git/`, README, `AGENTS.md`, an editor lockfile, …) is inert (library-guide-layout), outside the parsed, validated, rendered, listed and served set; per template in `slides/<name>/` and `sections/<name>/`: required files, `template.yaml` well-formed (a `usage:` key is a templates error, domain.constraint.template-defects-build-time), layout parses as standard html/template with the registry's function map (the helpers `media`, `section`, `dict`, `list`), errors file:line-qualified; the registry's build checks then reject reference cycles with the chain in the error — a reference is a declared `sections:` acceptance or a `section` helper call in a layout (section-helper-load-checks) —, reject any composition chain deeper than six heading levels, check each `section` helper call (the target is a defined section-usage template, literal `dict` keys are declared fields, required fields are present or defaulted, no target declares a min>0 child section), and validate each `example.md` — including a container template's example with nested instances — recursively; themes have theme.css; references — in a theme's `theme.css` and every stylesheet it imports (the same theme dir, another theme dir, or `media/`; imports followed, bounded and cycle-safe across the whole import graph, cycles detected): a relative `url()`/`@import` resolves from the importing file's own location and must stay inside that file's own tree (its theme directory, or `media/` for a stylesheet imported through `media:`; cross-tree reach is only through `media:` / `theme:<name>/`), a `url()`/`@import` with the reserved `media:` prefix resolves to an existing file under the resolved root's `media/` (relative and staying within `media/`), and a `url()`/`@import` with the reserved `theme:<name>/` prefix resolves to an existing file inside that theme's directory (an unknown `<name>` is an error); a missing file, an absolute path, a `..` leaving its own tree, or any other scheme is file:line-qualified to the offending CSS; plus layout src/href inside the resolved library and every layout `media "path"` argument relative and staying within the resolved root's `media/`, naming an existing file, layout violations file:line-qualified to the layout), assigns each template its kind from its directory, parses each `template.yaml` into the template schema model and registers templates (template-registry) and themes (theme-registry); returns the first templates error path-qualified. Single source for start, templates, gallery and reload. A running session resolves the startup-pinned `templates:` value; a changed value keeps the pinned root and the reload pipeline surfaces the restart-required error (see solution.component.http-server, template-retarget-requires-restart, global.constraint.never-serve-broken-deck).
